subject: integration
name: SQLite (sqlite3.wasm)
summary: The SQLite engine (sqlite3.wasm, version 3.53.4) that Orivon keeps once for every site that declares it by its hash; the copy is served only when the site's own file hashes to the same value, which is why the file's SHA-256 is filed too. Public-domain source, pure logic with no imports that reach a network, and no state or grant of its own. Judged here by its publisher.
